mapper.select: SELECT id, name, contact_person AS contactPerson, phone, status, sort, sales FROM mms_merchant ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, name, contact_person AS contactPerson, phone, email, address, logo, description, status, sort, sales FROM mms_merchant WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, name, contact_person AS contactPerson, phone, status, sort, sales FROM mms_merchant
AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
AND id = #{id}
ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
